purpose: Check whether a materially different PRE-only signal family is ready to challenge the current score-dominance winning-path candidate without using RESULT, PAYOUT, protected holdouts, or post-hoc fitting.

findings.adapter_behavior: Deterministically injects externally supplied coefficients into C1/N1 probability generators; it does not fit those coefficients itself.
findings.zero_coefficient_semantics: Designed to reduce to the corresponding PL control when line coefficients are zero.

candidate_comparison.reason: The line architecture is an orthogonal feature carrier but currently lacks legitimately fitted and unseen-validated coefficients, so promoting it now would add freedom without evidence.
candidate_comparison.owner_hypotheses: Girls/final/solo/line structure remain logged strata or future research hypotheses, not current purchase-rule modifiers.

future_safe_route: Keep the current frozen forward lane unchanged.
If later governance permits legitimate training evidence, fit line coefficients only on authorized training/calibration data with a fixed protocol.
Preregister the resulting line challenger before exposing it to later unseen prospective outcomes.
Require it to beat the frozen score-dominance lane on proper scoring/calibration and economic robustness, not merely raw hit count.
Do not promote from the same sample used to discover subgroup or coefficient behavior.
